steps.text: Newton's law: F = GMm/r², always attractive.
Field strength g = F/m = GM/r² — an inverse-square law.
Gravitational potential energy and potential are negative and become less negative with height.
Satellite orbits: the centripetal force is provided by gravity.
Kepler's third law: T² ∝ r³; a geostationary orbit has T = 24 h and stays above one point.
Escape speed is reached when the total energy is zero: v = √(2GM/r).
